▌ Warp Period: After the Version 4.2 update on 2026/04/22 – 2026/05/13 11:59 (server time)"},{"insert":"
","attributes":{"header":4}},{"insert":"● The limited 5-star characters Silver Wolf LV.999 (Elation: Imaginary), The Dahlia (Nihility: Fire), Castorice (Remembrance: Quantum), and Firefly (Destruction: Fire), as well as 4-star characters Gallagher (Abundance: Fire), Xueyi (Destruction: Quantum), and Hook (Destruction: Fire) will receive a limited-time drop-rate boost.
● The limited 5-star Light Cones Welcome to the Cosmic City (Elation), Never Forget Her Flame (Nihility), Make Farewells More Beautiful (Remembrance), and Whereabouts Should Dreams Rest (Destruction), as well as the 4-star Light Cones Poised to Bloom (Harmony), Indelible Promise (Destruction), and Eyes of the Prey (Nihility) will receive a time-limited drop-rate boost.
"},{"insert":{"image":"https://upload-os-bbs.hoyolab.com/upload/2026/04/21/e29cbc619324a950831b90ee2a48d591_1475907513720384342.jpg"},"attributes":{"align":"img-center","height":1350,"width":1080,"size":"341390"}},{"insert":{"image":"https://upload-os-bbs.hoyolab.com/upload/2026/04/21/d3b6ecf5a18974d17d3baa25452c7d6b_6645829497723265109.jpg"},"attributes":{"align":"img-center","height":1080,"width":1080,"size":"261608"}},{"insert":"
▌ "Godmode Player" & "Brilliant Fixation: Welcome to the Cosmic City" Event Warps"},{"insert":"
","attributes":{"header":4}},{"insert":"● During the "Godmode Player" Character Event Warp, the limited 5-star character Silver Wolf LV.999 (Elation: Imaginary) and 4-star characters Gallagher (Abundance: Fire), Xueyi (Destruction: Quantum), and Hook (Destruction: Fire) will receive a limited-time drop-rate boost.
● During the "Brilliant Fixation: Welcome to the Cosmic City" Light Cone Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star Light Cone Welcome to the Cosmic City (Elation) and the 4-star Light Cones Poised to Bloom (Harmony), Indelible Promise (Destruction), and Eyes of the Prey (Nihility) will be boosted for a limited time.
▌ "Indelible Coterie: The Dahlia" & "Coalesced Truths: Never Forget Her Flame" Event Warps"},{"insert":"
","attributes":{"header":4}},{"insert":"● During the "Indelible Coterie: The Dahlia" Character Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star character The Dahlia (Nihility: Fire) and 4-star characters Gallagher (Abundance: Fire), Xueyi (Destruction: Quantum), and Hook (Destruction: Fire) will be boosted for a limited time.
● During the "Coalesced Truths: Never Forget Her Flame" Light Cone Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star Light Cone Never Forget Her Flame (Nihility) and the 4-star Light Cones Poised to Bloom (Harmony), Indelible Promise (Destruction), and Eyes of the Prey (Nihility) will be boosted for a limited time.
▌ "Indelible Coterie: Castorice" & "Coalesced Truths: Make Farewells More Beautiful" Event Warp"},{"insert":"
","attributes":{"header":4}},{"insert":"● During the "Indelible Coterie: Castorice" Character Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star character Castorice (Remembrance: Quantum) and 4-star characters Gallagher (Abundance: Fire), Xueyi (Destruction: Quantum), and Hook (Destruction: Fire) will be boosted for a limited time.
● During the "Coalesced Truths: Make Farewells More Beautiful" Light Cone Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star Light Cone Make Farewells More Beautiful (Remembrance), the 4-star Light Cones Poised to Bloom (Harmony), Indelible Promise (Destruction), and Eyes of the Prey (Nihility) will be boosted for a limited time.
▌ "Indelible Coterie: Firefly" & "Coalesced Truths: Whereabouts Should Dreams Rest" Event Warp"},{"insert":"
","attributes":{"header":4}},{"insert":"● During the "Indelible Coterie: Firefly" Character Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star character Firefly (Destruction: Fire) and 4-star characters Gallagher (Abundance: Fire), Xueyi (Destruction: Quantum), and Hook (Destruction: Fire) will be boosted for a limited time.
● During the "Coalesced Truths: Whereabouts Should Dreams Rest" Light Cone Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star Light Cone Whereabouts Should Dreams Rest (Destruction) and the 4-star Light Cones Poised to Bloom (Harmony), Indelible Promise (Destruction), and Eyes of the Prey (Nihility) will be boosted for a limited time.

▌ Event Warp Details"},{"insert":"
","attributes":{"header":4}},{"insert":"※ Among the above characters and Light Cones, limited characters and limited Light Cones will not be available in the "Stellar Warp."
※ In this phase of Warp, obtainable 5-star characters include the featured 5-star characters and the custom-selected characters from "Celestial Invitation."
※ During the Event Warp period, the limited 5-star character Silver Wolf LV.999 (Elation: Imaginary) can only be obtained from the "Godmode Player" Character Event Warp, and the limited 5-star characters The Dahlia (Nihility: Fire), Castorice (Remembrance: Quantum), and Firefly (Destruction: Fire) can only be obtained from the corresponding "Indelible Coterie" Character Event Warps.
※ During the Event Warp, the limited 5-star Light Cone Welcome to the Cosmic City (Elation) can only be obtained from the "Brilliant Fixation: Welcome to the Cosmic City" Light Cone Event Warp. The limited 5-star Light Cones Never Forget Her Flame (Nihility), Make Farewells More Beautiful (Remembrance), and Whereabouts Should Dreams Rest (Destruction) can only be obtained from the corresponding "Coalesced Truths" Light Cone Event Warps.
※ "Godmode Player" and "Indelible Coterie" are Character Event Warps that share the same guaranteed drop counter. The cumulative Warp count for a guaranteed 5-star character in any Character Event Warp will always be carried over to other Character Event Warps, but is independent of and unaffected by other types of Warps.
※ "Brilliant Fixation" and "Coalesced Truths" are considered Light Cone Event Warps, and share the same guaranteed drop counter. The cumulative Warp count for a guaranteed 5-star Light Cone in any Light Cone Event Warp will always be carried over to other Light Cone Event Warps, but is independent of and unaffected by other types of Warps.
※ The "Indelible Coterie" Character Event Warp and the "Coalesced Truths" Light Cone Event Warp will irregularly become available in future version updates. For more details, please stay tuned for official announcements.
※ For more details, please head to the Warp screen.

▌ "Aptitude Showcase" Character Trial Event"},{"insert":"
","attributes":{"header":4}},{"insert":"● Requirement: Unlock Travel Log
● Event Details: After the Version 4.2 update — 2026/05/13 11:59 (server time), trial characters Silver Wolf LV.999 (Elation: Imaginary), The Dahlia (Nihility: Fire), Castorice (Remembrance: Quantum), Firefly (Destruction: Fire), Gallagher (Abundance: Fire), Xueyi (Destruction: Quantum), and Hook (Destruction: Fire) can be used to experience the stages. Upon completing the challenges, Trailblazers can obtain Stellar Jades, Adventure Logs, Universal Enhancement Materials, and credits as rewards.
"}]
